errors.text: The Ti <15 at.% boundary contradicts the nominally equimolar CoCrFeNiTi composition, which contains approximately 20 at.% Ti.

The proposed 40 h milling at 250 rpm and 5 min SPS dwell substantially depart from the target 1–6 h at 400 rpm and 10 min dwell, potentially causing contamination, excessive strain, or phase evolution.

The nanoindentation experiment does not independently vary grain size while holding composition and phase fractions constant, so it cannot distinguish Hall–Petch strengthening from solute strengthening.
The falsification logic is reversed: failure of hardness to track grain refinement would undermine the grain-refinement claim, not falsify solute strengthening.
